name: Last Lightbulb Garden
description: A field where glowing lightbulbs grow like flowers at twilight.
prompt: A single poetic image: a vast twilight meadow where hundreds of vintage glass lightbulbs grow from slender green stems like luminous flowers, warm tungsten glow, soft mist, a winding path, distant hills, fireflies mingling with bulb light, magical realism, rich detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Plant a little light. Watch it grow. 💡🌱
